summary: Flags loaded from a story flags file of a party preset (esv::script::GlobalFlagsLoadSystem::LoadStoryFlagsFile on macOS = bg3.exe+0x2EBAF60); feeds the Osiris event StoryGameEventManager::OnAllLoadedFlagsInPresetReceivedEvent.

fields.name: Flags
fields.evidence: Creator bg3.exe+0x2EBB620 zeroes an Array header (+0 ptr, +8 capacity, +0xC size); destructor bg3.exe+0x686280 = FUN_1405BD630 + free (no element destructor). bg3.exe+0x2EBAF60 reads the flags file into a local array and copies it with FUN_140591AE0, which copies elements as two 8-byte words with stride 0x10 = 16-byte POD (flag UUIDs).

open_questions: Elements are 16-byte POD; Guid (flag UUID) is inferred from the size and the flags context.
